scripts.dev: concurrently "npm run dev --prefix server" "npm run dev --prefix client"
scripts.build: npm install --prefix server && npm install --prefix client && npm run build --prefix client
scripts.postinstall: node -e "if(process.env.RENDER){require('child_process').execSync('npm install --prefix server && npm install --prefix client && npm run build --prefix client',{stdio:'inherit'})}"
